definitions.CDODescription:
This field can be used to send in a single, flat issued component to the service.  Prior to any other processing for the service, the appropriate requirement will be retrieved, and an issue detail/issue actual will be built from the requirement/issued component in the normal format of the service.
It is expected that this field would be useful for the case that only one issued component is passed in, or where the service is running from an interface that doesn't provide state management for the requirements.

definitions.CDODescription: Component Issue is used to select and (optionally) track which raw material lots or subassemblies were used at a particular manufacturing step. The correct components to issue and the proper quantities are indicated by the Material List CDO collection of

Component Issue is used to select and (optionally) track which raw material lots or subassemblies were used at a particular manufacturing step. The correct components to issue and the proper quantities are indicated by the Material List CDO collection of the Bill of Material. Another variation of component issue is an issue from “floor-stock”. In this case, material is decremented against a location or bin not a container. InSite should support both material issues as defined in a Bill structure ( Bill Control condition ) as well as material issues that are not specified in a predefined  BOM ( Non-Bill Control condition ).
